end.parentNote: Myra practised measuring grid sides by counting the gaps between dots, and used recounting to check answers. They noticed that dots and gaps give different counts, but this mix-up was still present at the end of the lesson. At home, draw a short line on dot paper and have Myra mark the two endpoint dots, then count only the spaces between them aloud.
